title: Assemble server-derived Foundation context selection
description: Prerequisite for task-203a5ca7aada4375a98a95df8773e249; hard-depend on task-c7f2530b4a4445398a5e572f0568ea1d, task-a3e8a02ddb864c689ac66de7b66bfceb, and the durable journal task-04dd5a0a9631484f9b7fe68897c3efac. Current disk has zero production selectContext/renderContext caller and no durable source for the design's mandatory Foundation context. Land the server-only ContextSelectionInput authority; do not treat a test fixture or a caller item list as the missing source.
definitionOfDone: Planning freezes a complete, versioned authority matrix for every mandatory Foundation context item named by design section 14.2—goal/node objective, criteria, policy revision, graph/manifest, approved plan, node authority/dependency/artifact closure, input tree/lease/epoch/workspace/scope, budgets/coverage, and legal next commands—plus optional journal/findings, exclusions, stable item ids/sections, and the provider-backed byte budget; any item lacking a durable reader blocks rather than defaults.

A server-only `assembleFoundationContextSelection`-style surface accepts only project/session/node/attempt identity, reads every item from the same durable graph/config/input/lease/journal snapshot, and calls public `@moe/context.selectContext`; caller text, items, exclusions, priority, ordering, graph/config bytes, and byteBudget are unrepresentable.

Success returns one deeply frozen AdmittedContextSelection plus provenance that binds project/session/node/attempt, graph revision/hash/epoch, configuration digest, sealed input-manifest digest, journal horizon/digest, and the exact provider context limit used; repeated unchanged reads serialize identically.

Missing/stale/foreign/ambiguous/unreadable durable facts refuse with exact stable source code/layer; invalid/overflow budget preserves `INVALID_CONTEXT_BUDGET` or `CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE` at `CONTEXT_SELECTION`, and no partial selection gains authority.

Real SqliteEventStore tests seed facts only through their production writers, cover one complete accepted Foundation control and a positive matrix of missing/stale/cross-binding/oversize cases, assert exact code/layer and zero writes, and prove a caller-proposed item or budget cannot affect output.

Mutation drills omitting one mandatory production item or substituting caller content redden named assertions; daemon tests/typecheck execute nonvacuously and completion names task-203a5ca7aada4375a98a95df8773e249 as consumer.
taskRails: Own only apps/daemon/src/work/foundation-context-selection.ts, its exact one-line LF .js bridge, and its focused test; production source <=250 lines.

Do not invent item mappings/budget during implementation: if planning cannot verify every reader, report blocked and file measured prerequisites. Optional=[] is not an implicit default; it requires an explicit Foundation policy decision.
Use public @moe/context root and production durable readers; no deep imports, local selection/ranking, caller context/graph/config/journal, or mock-backed accepted journey.
Preserve upstream source/context refusal code and layer, TDD exact assertions/nonzero cases, and explicit owned-path commit.
